value.rationale: This is a complete intrinsic S_n homology character of a natural and widely studied constant-weight subspace of the binary cube, not merely a small Betti-number computation. The distinction from full-hypercube and lower-weight filtration representations is structural: the constant-weight layer supports degree-two classes, with transposition traces not determined by dimensions. The all-n formula is motivated by geometric combinatorics of Johnson graph stars/tops and can be evaluated on arbitrary permutations; it is a natural classification rather than a selected tiny parameter.
